_doc: Neck pitch-to-head cradle on the pitch servo case (Idle T-acpw7j): the cradle's rear plate (combined__neck_pitch_to_head_cradle, build_neck_head_connectors.py stage 3) lies on the XM335 pitch case's rear face (its -x case face, manifest +y) and is held by 4 screws into the case's M2 taps (connector_screws.json neck_pitch_to_head_cradle, XM335.case-x.1..4), driven from behind the case (neck_head:s008). Catalogue hardware only (owner 2026-11-22), no sleeves: the plate has plain clearance holes (hole_dia, ISO 273 medium M2), cut as 45 deg teardrops pointing up in the print direction (process up -z, manifest -z), flat at teardrop_flat_mm from the axis; each ISO 7380-1 M2 button head bears on an ISO 7089 M2 washer (washer) on the plate's rear face. Why a washer: a bare M2 button head (dk 3.5) on the 2.4 mm hole leaves a 0.55 mm ring of plastic under it, less than one 0.62 mm line of the 0.6 mm nozzle, 5.1 mm2 of bearing; the washer's 2.4 .. 5.0 mm ring is 15.1 mm2 (2.96 x, so 2.96 x lower contact pressure on the PAHT-CF at the same preload) and 1.3 mm wide (2.1 lines); the head bears on the washer's 2.2 .. 3.5 mm ring. The washer is the body's existing hw:M2-washer-2.2-5-x-0.3 line. Plate thickness: the case's taps are 1.8 mm deep in the CAD at the blind holes case-x.1 / .3 (drawing max tap depth 2.0, through holes .2 / .4 capped to 2.0) from a seat 0.2 mm outside the opening (defined_holes.seat_sites), so no length reaches the 2.0 mm reference at the blind holes without the thread passing their bottom; the target engagement is the shallowest tap (1.8, the full modelled thread), and the plate is plate_t = L - point - target - seat_offset - washer h for the shortest standard ISO 7380-1 M2 length L whose plate is at least plate_min_mm (common.pitch_case_joint): M2x4 leaves 1.2, M2x5 leaves 2.2 (rear face 0.3 mm in front of the earlier 2.5 mm plate, so the head top stays where it was). minus_x_edge: the plate's -x end (x_mm) has corner_r_mm rounds on its two vertical corners instead of the 1.6 mm default (at 1.6 the round on a 2.2 .. 2.5 mm plate left 0.63 .. 0.91 mm of wall beside the hole); the end is not moved outward: at neck pitch +20 .. +28 deg the plate's bottom rear corner passes 0.09 .. 0.25 mm from the neck collar (head_neck_collar, sampled sweep, T-acpw7j), and a strip out to x -14.6 / -15.4 reached into the collar's path. head_clear_mm: radial clearance of the washer kept free behind the plate.

washer.source: ISO 7089 M2: d1 2.2, d2 5.0, h 0.3 (the body's hw:M2-washer-2.2-5-x-0.3 line, robot/body/torso/build_torso_carriers.bom.yaml)
